name: Firewall Exception Added Then Logon
description: A rule is added to the Windows Firewall exception list (4946) and a logon follows (4624) — opening a path in and then using it, the tail end of enabling remote access on a host that did not have it. 4946 is routine on a machine that receives software (ordinary installers add their own rules) and needs filtering-platform policy-change auditing enabled, so check which port the rule opened.
